pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Patch geometry varies from quadrangular to hexagonal across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh with distinct triple-junction nodes. Pixel thickness is consistent across the upper neck and flank, with slight widening at the shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, consisting of upright hair clusters of varying vertical amplitude.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small avian organisms perched along the dorsal ridge and posterior shoulder region.
